# Accessor: cellDimensions

## Get Signature

```ts
get cellDimensions(): object;
```

Effective tile cell dimensions used by the layer grid.

### Returns

`object`

| Name | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `height` | `number` |
| `width` | `number` |
